title: Surreal AI Art Video A Journey Through Strange Beauty “Betrayal” – Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
For this one it started out as just some pretty #Midjourney images with women in beautiful scenes. But as I went on I realized the clothing in some of these images is amazing. This song is called Betrayal. Animated with #VEO3. I love the peaceful quality in this one.This is only the partial song as I can only make videos under 3 mins. Full song is available on my band camp. Music made with @suno  but I write the lyrics with help of ai. I only started making songs because I needed music longer than I- 1.5 mins for my videos but now I look forward to making the songs so much. Thank you all for watching and listening. Means the world to me ❤️❤️❤️ 

#ai #suno #aiimages #aiart #aivideo #aimusic
